name: parsonspuzzlesutd
description: Repo-level scripts. The apps live in frontend/, backend/ and lean-worker/, each with its own package.json.

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix backend
scripts.dev:fullstack: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names lean,api,web "npm run dev:lean" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev"
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:lean
